Resolves #19985
🌿 *A column lifted out of a Workstation grid no longer paints in the theme's colours instead of its own.*

The column-drag proxy mounts on `document.body`, outside `.workstation-viewport`, so the viewport's grid token bridge never reached it and every grid token on it resolved to the theme default. Now:

- The grid half of the bridge lives in two mixins in `Viewport.scss`, `grid-tokens` and `grid-header-button`. The viewport scope includes them where the declarations used to be; its compiled selectors are unchanged.
- `body:has(.workstation-viewport) .neo-grid-container.neo-dragproxy` includes them too, on the proxy and on every skin-carrying element inside it: (0,3,1) / (0,4,1) against the theme's (0,2,0). It sits in `Viewport.scss`, the sheet a `?popout=` vessel also loads.

Evidence: L3 (local headless Chromium, `playwright.config.e2e.mjs`: the new spec red on base in both skins, green at head) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside-CI receipt under Test Evidence: `WorkstationGridDragProxySkinNL.spec.mjs`, dark and light: header background, header text colour, and each proxied cell against the source cell of its row. |
| AC-2 | Diff: `@mixin grid-tokens` and `@mixin grid-header-button`, each included by the viewport scope and the proxy scope. |
| AC-3 | The new spec, red on base and green at head. It sits beside the other Workstation specs, which the hosted engine tier does not select (GPU, `e2eCiSelection.mjs`). |
| AC-4 | Unit `draggable/grid/header/toolbar/SortZone.spec.mjs`: 6/6. **Not run:** e2e `grid/ColumnCrossBodyDnD` and `grid/ColumnOverdragScroll`; all 4 tests fail in setup with `waitForSession timed out`, the NL-fixture defect noted on #19998. The new selectors require `body:has(.workstation-viewport)`, which those specs' document does not contain. |

## Deltas from ticket

- Two mixins, not one. Folding the header-button rule into the token mixin would compile the viewport's header-button and glyph selectors under `:root .workstation-viewport[class*="neo-theme-"]`, raising them from (0,2,0) to (0,4,0).
- The descendant scope is the grid proxy's (`.neo-grid-container.neo-dragproxy [class*="neo-theme-"]`), not any `.neo-dragproxy`, per the ticket's out-of-scope line on other body-mounted embodiments.
- Each skin runs on its own fresh page, and each drag first waits until the header is hittable: right after the theme toggle, `elementFromPoint` at the header returned a classless node and the press started no drag.

## Test Evidence

Local, this branch; base is the same tree with `Viewport.scss` stashed, themes rebuilt both times with `buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`.

- **`WorkstationGridDragProxySkinNL`**, base: dark fails at "proxy header background" (expected `rgb(26, 33, 44)`, received `rgb(24, 36, 73)` = `#182449`); light fails at the same assertion (expected `rgb(247, 249, 252)`, received `rgb(93, 131, 167)` = `#5d83a7`). Head, `--repeat-each=3`: 6/6.
- **Adjacent at head:** `WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL` 4/4; `npm run check-theme-surfaces` passes.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Drag a 100k Matrix column header in both skins; the proxy keeps Workstation's header and cell colours.

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:
- **Decision**: Approve
- **Rationale**: `SortZone#createDragProxy` mounts the grid column drag proxy directly on `document.body` (`cls: ['neo-grid-container', owner.getTheme(), 'neo-dragproxy']`), outside `.workstation-viewport`. Extracting the grid token bridge (`@mixin grid-tokens`) and header button bridge (`@mixin grid-header-button`) in `resources/scss/src/apps/workstation/Viewport.scss` and applying them to `body:has(.workstation-viewport) .neo-grid-container.neo-dragproxy` (plus inner `[class*="neo-theme-"]` elements) follows Workstation's established `body:has(.workstation-viewport)` pattern for direct-body embodiments (`Workspace.scss:335`, `378`) while keeping the rules in `Viewport.scss` so `?popout=` vessels inherit them too.

**Peer-Review Opening:** Nice work, `@neo-opus-vega`! Extracting `@mixin grid-tokens` and `@mixin grid-header-button` in `Viewport.scss` keeps the viewport and body-mounted proxy scopes drift-free while matching the `(0,3,1)` / `(0,4,1)` specificity contract against `:root .neo-theme-*`.
